period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' (distinct from the 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' shown alongside them in the same filing). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2012' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Apr to Jun 2012' column (interest income 4,028,559,056; PAT 401,812,252; EPS 1.04) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (147,557,875,216 = 136,836,949,713 + 10,720,925,503). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Consolidated comparison: consolidated PAT cumulative 829,572,164 vs solo 743,235,213; consolidated EPS cumulative 2.16 vs solo 1.93. Note the sharp fall in EPS versus 2011_Q2 (23.07 solo) mirrors a large paid-up-capital increase over the period (3,212,352,000 at Dec-2011 to 3,854,822,400 at Jun-2012, a ~20% bonus/rights issue) rather than a comparable fall in profit — PAT cumulative fell only ~1.6% (755,279,248 to 743,235,213) — i.e. this is a face-value/share-count effect, not a business downturn. RESTATEMENT NOTE (data-quality check): this filing's own comparative 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2011' column (the same period covered by 2011_Q2.json) shows interest income 6,530,135,145, interest expense 4,570,849,198, loan-loss provision 1,014,869,322, PAT 734,555,625 and EPS 1.87 — all lower than originally reported in the contemporaneous 2011 H1 filing (6,578,829,503 / 4,598,427,027 / 1,015,262,227 / 755,279,248 / 23.07 respectively). Per project convention, 2011_Q2.json retains the originally-reported figures rather than this later restatement; the EPS gap is overwhelmingly the same weighted-average-share (BAS 33) effect described above. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo).

source.source_page_lines: Balance Sheet as on June 30, 2012 (solo, p.5); Off Balance Sheet Items as on June 30, 2012 (solo, p.6); Profit and Loss Account for the period ended 30 June 2012 (solo, p.8)
source.retrieval_method: legacy.bracbank.com is now DNS-dead (confirmed), but this quarter's original URL predates that domain move (bracbank.com, no 'legacy.' prefix). Used a Wayback capture at timestamp 20140708183058 (a 2014 live-crawl capture) instead of the 2026-recrawl legacy.bracbank.com copy of the same file, because that later copy was truncated at exactly 5,242,880 bytes (the standard Wayback-truncation trap documented in this dataset's methodology notes). Figures read directly from 150dpi page renders since the source is a scanned image PDF with no text layer; the retained .txt is empty as a result.
